article.title: If you blinked this summer, here’s what you missed on X
article.preview_text: From the biggest World Cup moments that exploded on the timeline, to the world’s most powerful voices joining (and rejoining) X; from open-sourcing how For You actually ranks, to a raft of new ad

blocks.text: From the biggest World Cup moments that exploded on the timeline, to the world’s most powerful voices joining (and rejoining) X; from open-sourcing how For You actually ranks, to a raft of new ad products and features that make advertising simpler to launch, measure and convert on X. It has been a record-breaking summer and here are some of the highlights you might have missed.

@Monique_X, Head of Global Advertising at SpaceXAI, said: “The summer was a great reminder of what X stands for. One public conversation – world events as they happen, culture as it forms, and the people shaping original ideas and what comes next, all in one place. The velocity of new products over the last few weeks is helping brands show up in that timeline, with a clearer view of how it ranks. The work has only just begun.”
The voices on X

The leaders of some of the world’s biggest companies chose X to speak unfiltered, at scale. Mark Zuckerberg posted for the first time in three years, Jensen Huang used the platform to explain the industry and LVMH’s Bernard Arnault and new Apple CEO John Ternus joined the global public square.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup held global attention

The 2026 FIFA World Cup owned July and August.  Globally, more than 8M unique authors, 53.9M original posts, 14B video views, 2B likes and 136B impressions lit up the timeline – enough to fill every seat in every World Cup stadium more than 1500 times over.
The energy didn't stop after the trophy was lifted.
NFL season starts now

NFL Gametime on X launched and is now live ahead of kickoff tomorrow, September 9th. A new fan experience brings real-time scores and stats, official team content, news, creators and ongoing NFL conversation into one seamless destination across the platform – developed with the NFL and designed by SpaceXAI.

Inside The NFL is back for a second season also premiering tomorrow, September 9th. Fans get premium football content throughout the season, including hundreds of clips, mic’d up moments and X exclusive game edits.
Industry-leading transparency – and more reach

X took another step towards unprecedented transparency by open-sourcing more of the For You timeline ranking code and launched a new tool, Under the Hood, so now anyone can see how posts are ranked and if visibility is limited. For brands, this brings more confidence in the environment their ads appear in.

A small tweak enabled a Mutuals boost making posts from accounts you follow back travel further. And early results saw a lift of +3.15% on replies and +1.8% on original posts, with more reach for smaller accounts.

The proof came independently when Prescient AI’s Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) found X the most efficient channel in the study. The data showed 5.42x ROAS, 143% above the same brands’ other channels – and once marketers could see the full incremental impact, they scaled their investment with confidence and grew spend 101% in the next three months. Prescient’s recommendation: ‘run X across the full funnel’.
Smaller advertisers used the same stack
Skytech Gaming, an SMB operating in a tough PC market, put that to work in Q2: 10x ROAS on just $7.6k spend – $83.5k in revenue, never below 4x in any week. See the full case study:

That result sits on the rebuilt X Ads Manager. The brief was simple: a business shouldn’t need a huge team or budget to perform well on X. This summer closed more of that gap – ads that are easier to make, leads captured without leaving X and performance that can be seen without a specialist team. SMBs can now create, measure and convert in the same conversation as the biggest brands on X.
New ad products launched this summer that are already getting brands results on X:
X Ads MCP: enables advertisers to create, manage, optimize and measure campaigns on X directly from the AI tools they already use, including Grok and other MCP-compatible agents.
Lead Gen Ads: our most requested new ad format that allows advertisers to collect contact information and leads directly within the ad without users leaving X.

Mentions Boost: Available to Premium Business subscribers, lets brands instantly amplify organic posts that mention them, add custom CTAs and destination URLs and turn authentic customer conversations into performance campaigns – no new creative required.
See the full Summer rundown of all the X Ads platform updates supporting advertisers of all sizes across the full funnel.
Rewarding creators for original ideas

The conversation on X is built by a broad range of creators. Continuing our focus on rewarding original content, this summer X replaced Revenue Sharing with Original Content Rewards so payouts follow fresh ideas, reporting and commentary which drives genuine conversation and engagement. Existing members can apply from today, September 8th.
New X creator tools landed too including Live Studio for desktop livestreams, and a new Video Editor.

Prioritizing original creator content complements X’s AI-powered platform Creator Connect*, which is now connecting brands with the voices that align with their campaign goals to help them reach the right audiences and drive meaningful results. *Currently US only
What’s next this season?

The momentum continues. Product development keeps moving at pace enabling more ways for brands and creators to connect with audiences and communities. Live sport is back, cultural moments keep coming and the run-up to shopping and holiday season sets the stage for much more.
